<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the functional group and bond change criteria described for the cyclization of chalcones to flavanones. I will use a representative flavanone SMILES (O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12) as the target molecule for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1OC(Cc2ccccc2)C2=CC=CC=C12",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
